inline_comments.body: Could you keep me on the here? I'd like to stay informed about changes to the OpenAI API.
ping @aoshen02 when  modifying the scale_out entrypoint.
This will override the CODEOWNERS rules in the parent files, causing token_in_token_out and factories to only ping @aoshen02. It would be better to add @aoshen02 to /vllm/entrypoints/scale_out.

> Could you please add @aoshen02 to these three paths, while preserving the existing owners?
> /vllm/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out @noooop @DarkLight1337 @aoshen02
> /vllm/entrypoints/scale_out/factories.py @noooop @DarkLight1337 @aoshen02
> /rust/src/server/src/routes/inference @BugenZhao @njhill @aoshen02

I think @aoshen02 wanted to “let me know” about the changes to this file, rather than review all the changes to these files.
The line `/vllm/entrypoints/scale_out @noooop @DarkLight1337` should already ping you for all `scale_out` changes, including those ones, unless I misunderstood how CODEOWNERS works

issue_comments.body:
Thanks for consolidating CODEOWNERS here. I have removed the ownership changes from #61042 to keep that PR focused on endpoint diagnostics.

Could you please add @aoshen02 to these three paths, while preserving the existing owners?

```text
/vllm/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out @noooop @DarkLight1337 @aoshen02
/vllm/entrypoints/scale_out/factories.py @noooop @DarkLight1337 @aoshen02
/rust/src/server/src/routes/inference @BugenZhao @njhill @aoshen02
```

This covers the Python TITO implementation, its route registration, and the Rust inference routes without assigning ownership of all scale-out endpoints or the generic Rust routes.rs file.
